answer: Mechanism: burn-based identity fee. Each new agent identity permanently burns a small fee, and the burn scales with consecutive creation speed. Honest operators pay once and barely notice. An attacker minting a fleet pays a rising curve, each fake costlier than the last, like plumes of smoke from an ever-hungrier fire. Burned units return to no one, so attacks burn real resources while the network loses nothing. A willow bends in storms; the fee bends with volume and survives floods. Purity shows like a lotus: an account that never needed bulk creation rises clean from the ledger's mud.
